definitions.explanation: The yellow part of an egg, as opposed to the white ({白身|しろみ}).

examples.japanese: {黄身|きみ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}ったら→割る：02334_waru⟧{黄身|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When I cracked the egg, it had two yolks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黄身|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とろり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{流|なが}れ{出|で}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おいしい⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧だ。
examples.english: The best part of this dish is the way the soft-boiled yolk oozes out.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄身|きみ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to separate the yolk and the white
- ⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黄身|きみ}: a soft yolk
- {黄身|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: the yolk breaks

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{君|きみ}→君：01384_kimi⟧ (you) and close to ⟦{気味|きみ}→気味：13448_kimi⟧ (feeling, touch of); context always decides. In cooking and nutrition writing the yolk is also called ⟦{卵黄|らんおう}→卵黄：11976_ranou⟧.
